verdict.rationale: Recurly ships event-driven automation for specific domains. Dunning Management lets merchants configure what emails are sent, when retries occur, and what happens when a payment fails, with up to 50 targeted campaigns by segment or plan. Entitlements are granted automatically on subscription, and Engage flows trigger in-app prompts on payment failure. Anything broader means building your own logic on its webhooks; a community comparison notes dunning works without implementing webhooks. Missing for 10: a general-purpose user-defined rules/workflow engine (arbitrary event → condition → action), rule-builder documentation beyond dunning, Engage and entitlements, and independent hands-on corroboration of rule configuration depth.
